paper_analogy: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Graphs for Autonomous Search-and-Track
source: training_data.csv, Machine == 'lame', 16 row(s), 3 auto-detected run(s)/playthroughs. Graph built directly from the PTT (Penetration Testing Tree) field's growth.

analogy_mapping.Agent Nodes: PTT snapshot reached after each new tree item (state = cumulative tree)
analogy_mapping.Search Nodes: The PTT tree item worked on (number + title) + its MCP_tasks tool calls
analogy_mapping.Track Nodes: That item's findings payload -- what was actually discovered

node_types.Agent (Blue/Pink goal): PTT state after a new item completes
node_types.Search (Orange): PTT item being worked (tool calls in tooltip)

edge_types.StateTransition (Black): Agent -> Agent, label = PTT item number
edge_types.SearchUpdate (Green): Agent -> Search, item being worked from that state
edge_types.TrackUpdate (Blue): Search -> Track, what item's execution found
edge_types.Prediction (Purple): Track -> Agent, leads to next cumulative PTT state

[Run 2/3] 2.2 Enumerate Samba service:
The share enumeration on the IP address 10.129.237.13 reveals that the 'print$' share of type Disk is for Printer Drivers. Mapping, listing, and writing are all denied. The 'tmp' share of type Disk has a comment 'oh noes!'. Mapping and listing are allowed, but writing is denied. The 'opt' share of type Disk has mapping, listing, and writing all denied. The 'IPC$' and 'ADMIN$' shares of type IPC are IPC Services for a lame server running Samba 3.0.20-Debian. Mapping, listing, and writing statuses are not available or all denied. The server is part of the WORKGROUP workgroup with the master being LAME. An error occurred while trying to understand the response for listing '\*' on the server, resulting in a NT_STATUS_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED message.
